title: Microsoft Teams: external phone call routing in GCC High and DoD
summary: Hold for licensing corrections: Microsoft lists redirecting external phone calls as a Teams Phone feature, so its licence coverage is not unpublished or mixed. The routing controls, commands, defaults and roadmap details are supported.

claims.where: title; front matter: products
claims.claim: This change concerns Microsoft Teams external phone call routing.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams: External phone call routing (GCC High, DoD)

claims.where: front matter: status; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap status is Launched.
claims.quote: "status": "Launched", "statusKey": "launched"

claims.where: front matter: releasePhase; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists GCC High and DoD.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["GCC High", "DoD"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Desktop and Mac.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Desktop", "Mac"]

claims.where: front matter: targetDate; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap target is September CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "September CY2026"

claims.where: front matter: previewDate
claims.claim: The roadmap supplies no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.where: What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap describes redirecting all external phone calls to voicemail or unanswered settings.
claims.quote: External call routing will provide users the ability to redirect all external phone calls to either voicemail or their unanswered settings.

claims.where: What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap description does not name the individual routing settings.
claims.quote: External call routing will provide users the ability to redirect all external phone calls to either voicemail or their unanswered settings.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: PSTN routing is configured in Teams admin center at Voice > Calling policies > policy > Routing for PSTN calls.
claims.quote: select Voice > Calling policies. ... Choose the policy you would like to update or select Add to create a new policy. ... Select an option for Routing for PSTN calls.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity Global -InboundPstnCallRoutingTreatment Unanswered configures PSTN calls to use unanswered settings.
claims.quote: Setting this parameter lets you control how inbound PSTN calls should be routed. ... Unanswered: The inbound PSTN call will be routed according to the called user's unanswered call settings

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Federated routing is configured in Teams admin center at Voice > Calling policies > policy > Routing for federated calls.
claims.quote: select Voice > Calling policies. ... Select the policy you would like to update or select Add to create a new policy. ... Choose an option for Routing for federated calls.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity Global -InboundFederatedCallRoutingTreatment Voicemail sends federated calls directly to voicemail.
claims.quote: Setting this parameter lets you control how inbound federated calls should be routed. ... Voicemail: The inbound federated call will be routed directly to the called user's voicemail

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The user's unanswered destination is at Teams admin center > Users > Manage users > user > Voice > Call answering rules > If unanswered.
claims.quote: go to Users > Manage users and select a licensed user. ... go to the Voice tab. ... under Call answering rules ... To configure unanswered settings, select the appropriate setting in the If unanswered drop-down.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsUserCallingSettings -Identity user6@contoso.com -IsUnansweredEnabled $true -UnansweredTargetType Voicemail -UnansweredDelay 00:00:20 configures unanswered calls to voicemail.
claims.quote: This parameter controls whether forwarding for unanswered calls is enabled or not. ... For a user, supported values are Voicemail, SingleTarget, MyDelegates, and Group. ... 00:00:15, 00:00:20, 00:00:30

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; rationales: risk and impact
claims.claim: The control is admin-opt-in: default routing remains until an administrator configures a different treatment.
claims.quote: Use default settings The call is routed using your default inbound call routing settings. This is the default setting for PSTN and federated calls.

claims.where: controls[0].note; controls[1].note; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: RegularIncoming is the default for both routing parameters and makes no changes to default inbound routing.
claims.quote: RegularIncoming: No changes are made to default inbound routing. This is the default setting.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model
claims.claim: The entitlement model for the routing feature is mixed.
claims.quote: Redirect external phone calls | Send inbound calls from external callers to user's forwarding settings (for example, voicemail) while not impacting internal calls. | Image of a x for no | Image of a checkmark for yes
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/here-s-what-you-get-with-phone-system to sources and state in licensing.notes: 'Microsoft lists Redirect external phone calls with Microsoft Teams Enterprise plus Teams Phone, not with Microsoft Teams Enterprise alone.' Keep the existing licence-combination examples as background.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: PSTN calls originate from the public telephone network.
claims.quote: incoming calls that come from the Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN)

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Federated calls originate outside the tenant and not from the PSTN, including Teams calls from another tenant.
claims.quote: Federated calls are calls that don't originate from the PSTN and that are outside your tenant. For example, a call from Teams or Skype for Business that is from another tenant would be considered federated.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; changes: first briefing
claims.claim: Microsoft documents these routing settings as available in GCCH and DoD.
claims.quote: These policy settings are also available for GCCH & DoD use.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: An administrator can make external calls of the selected type always use voicemail or unanswered settings without individual user approval.
claims.quote: You can control whether these external calls should always be sent to voicemail, sent to unanswered settings, or use normal call routing. For PSTN calls, you can also allow your users within the policy to decide.

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Scope: Out of scope
claims.claim: PSTN routing supports RegularIncoming, Unanswered, Voicemail and UserOverride, with users choosing their routing in Teams call settings for UserOverride.
claims.quote: RegularIncoming: No changes are made to default inbound routing. ... Unanswered: ... Voicemail: ... UserOverride: Users can determine their PSTN call routing choice from call settings in the Teams app.

claims.where: controls[1].note; What's changing; Scope: Out of scope
claims.claim: Federated routing supports RegularIncoming, Unanswered and Voicemail, but not Let users decide.
claims.quote: These federated calls can be sent to voicemail, sent to unanswered settings, or use default call routing. ... Let users decide (PSTN calls only)

claims.where: controls[0].note; controls[1].note; What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Unanswered and Voicemail routing take precedence over forwarding, simultaneous delegate ringing and call groups.
claims.quote: If Use unanswered settings or Send to voicemail is used, either of these settings will have precedence over other call forwarding settings like call forwarding with simultaneous ringing to delegate, call groups, or call forwarding.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Send to voicemail routes directly to the called user's voicemail without presenting the call to the user.
claims.quote: Send to voicemail The call is routed directly to voicemail and isn't shown to the user.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: A call routed to voicemail is disconnected if voicemail is not enabled for the called user.
claims.quote: If the called user doesn't have voicemail enabled, the call will be disconnected.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Unanswered routing does not present the incoming external call to the called user.
claims.quote: The inbound PSTN call will be routed according to the called user's unanswered call settings and the call will not be presented to the called user.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: A call routed to unanswered settings is disconnected if the called user has not enabled unanswered call settings.
claims.quote: If the called user has not enabled unanswered call settings the call will be disconnected.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Under Unanswered routing the called user sees a missed call notification.
claims.quote: The called user will see a missed call notification.

claims.where: controls[].scope; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: Routing follows the users' calling policy, and changing Global affects the users on the Global default policy.
claims.quote: this script sets -InboundPstnCallRoutingTreatment to route inbound PSTN calls according to the unanswered call forwarding settings for users in the Global (default) Teams Calling Policy instance

claims.where: controls[2].governs; controls[2].note; Governance controls; Risk assessment
claims.claim: Unanswered routing uses the called user's per-user unanswered configuration rather than a destination stored in the calling policy.
claims.quote: Use unanswered settings The call is routed according to the unanswered call forwarding settings set for that user.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: A user's unanswered target can be MyDelegates or Group.
claims.quote: For a user, supported values are Voicemail, SingleTarget, MyDelegates, and Group.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The user's Voice tab requires an assigned Teams Phone licence.
claims.quote: If the Voice tab isn't visible, the user doesn't have a Microsoft Teams Phone license assigned.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Scope: Users
claims.claim: Per-user call-settings configuration is available only in Teams Only deployment mode.
claims.quote: This feature is only in Teams Only deployment mode.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Microsoft describes these policies as helping prevent unwanted external calls.
claims.quote: As an admin, you can create policies that help prevent your users from getting unwanted calls from external parties.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Messages left by callers in Cloud Voicemail are stored in the user's mailbox.
claims.quote: Voicemail messages generated by Cloud Voicemail are delivered to and stored in the user's Exchange mailbox, either in Exchange Online or in Exchange Server.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Scope: Users
claims.claim: The inbound-routing article applies to Microsoft Calling Plans, Operator Connect, Teams Phone Mobile and Direct Routing.
claims.quote: This article applies to Microsoft Calling Plans, Operator Connect, Teams Phone Mobile, and Direct Routing.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Scope: Users
claims.claim: Phone System in GCC High and DoD is delivered via Direct Routing.
claims.quote: Phone System and Audio Conferencing for GCC High and DoD environments are being delivered via Direct Routing.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Users requiring their own telephone number need licensing that includes Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Phone System.
claims.quote: All users who require their own telephone number to make and receive telephone calls must be assigned with licensing that includes the Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Phone System applications.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A legacy Microsoft 365 E5 licence includes Teams and Phone System.
claims.quote: A legacy Microsoft 365 E5 license - includes Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Phone System applications

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Teams Enterprise combined with Teams Phone Standard is a qualifying licence combination.
claims.quote: A Microsoft Teams Enterprise license combined with Microsoft Teams Phone Standard license

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A user also requires a Microsoft Calling Plan licence when Microsoft supplies PSTN access and phone numbers.
claims.quote: If you elect to use Microsoft to provide your PSTN access and phone numbers, in addition to Teams Phone licensing, the user also requires a Microsoft Calling Plan license.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: first paragraph; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The Routing inbound calls article itself names no licence, meter or charge for these routing settings.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams inbound call routing PSTN federated licensing GCC High DoD price default policy; opened the full Routing inbound calls article, which names no licence, meter or charge for these settings.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a licence covering these routing settings.
claims.quote: With Microsoft Teams Enterprise license | With Microsoft Teams Enterprise license + Teams Phone license ... Redirect external phone calls ... Image of a x for no | Image of a checkmark for yes
claims.fix: Replace the unpublished-licence wording in licensing.notes and Cost and licensing with: 'Microsoft lists Redirect external phone calls with Microsoft Teams Enterprise plus Teams Phone, not with Microsoft Teams Enterprise alone.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/here-s-what-you-get-with-phone-system. In Open questions, remove 'licence or' so the question concerns a separate charge only.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: A separate price for these routing settings, including a GCC High or DoD-specific routing price, is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams external call routing GCC High DoD separate license price charge; "inbound call routing" "price" "license". Opened Teams Phone licensing, Routing inbound calls, Teams Calling features and Office 365 GCC High and DoD; no separate routing price found.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: No source checked says that existing call behaviour changes automatically when the feature arrives.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams external inbound call routing security attack unchanged existing behavior rollout. Read the roadmap, Routing inbound calls and Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy; the documented default retains existing routing, with no automatic change stated.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The routing article does not describe these treatments as protection against a specific attack.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams inbound external call routing InboundPstnCallRoutingTreatment agent automated approval security attack. Opened Routing inbound calls and Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy; these treatments are described as unwanted-call routing, not a named attack defence.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: No agent or separate automated action is described for these two routing treatments.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams inbound external call routing InboundPstnCallRoutingTreatment agent automated approval security attack. Read Routing inbound calls and Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy; the treatments describe policy-based routing, not an agent or additional action.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The per-user unanswered setting supplies a destination rather than selecting external-call treatment by itself.
claims.quote: This policy setting controls how inbound PSTN calls should be routed. ... Use unanswered settings The call is routed according to the unanswered call forwarding settings set for that user.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Unmodified call answering rules forward unanswered calls to voicemail after 30 seconds by default.
claims.quote: If a user or tenant admin doesn't modify their call answering rules, unanswered calls are forwarded to voicemail after 30 seconds by default.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The displayed unmodified user settings can show an unanswered target of none and a 20-second delay.
claims.quote: The settings displayed for the user in Teams admin center or Teams PowerShell show the unanswered target as none and a delay of 20 seconds.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist asks readers to check voicemail enablement, but the controls table has no row for voicemail enablement.
claims.quote: Confirm that each affected user has voicemail enabled and unanswered call settings configured ... Controls table: Routing for PSTN calls; Routing for federated calls; If unanswered.
claims.fix: The Before rollout instruction to confirm voicemail enablement has no matching control row; the If unanswered row covers only the unanswered destination. Do not add a control row as part of this correction.
